t: On the wall of the Queen's Building of the Royal Courts of Justice, on Carey Street, passers-by spotted a Banksy mural on 8 September 2025. It showed a judge attacking an unarmed protester with a gavel. Activists read it as a comment on the legal crackdown on the protest group Palestine Action under the Terrorism Act 2000. The building, completed in 1968, is Grade II listed, and the mural was being removed the next day, on 9 September. Banksy announced it on Instagram, captioning it with the courts' name.
